ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to make opportunity field read only for terminal stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR( (AND( IsChanged(StageName), OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = 'Lost', TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = 'Closed' ) )), (AND( OR( Text(StageName) = 'Lost', Text(StageName) = 'Closed' ), OR( IsChanged(OwnerId), IsChanged(Name), IsChanged(CloseDate) ) )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Owner, Name, Stage, Close Date cannot be updated at this current stage.
